page_title: CEL 0-1 ESP | Celta Vigo v Espanyol 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is given a yellow card.
90+5' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is awarded a yellow card.
90+4' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jose Salinas (Espanyol) replacing Tyrhys Dolan.
90' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header high over the bar from close in.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is coming onto the pitch as Miguel Roman cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
86' Exposito (Espanyol) is about to take a corner kick.
86' Espanyol have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.

86' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee points to the corner flag and Espanyol will take a corner.
85' The free kick from long range, taken by Espanyol, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' Isidro Diaz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo). It's a free kick to Espanyol, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
83' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
82' Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
79' Borja Iglesias goes off the pitch and Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) comes on.
79' Here is a change. Fran Beltran is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
78' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
78' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Celta Vigo.
76' It is time for a substitution. Jofre (Espanyol) is on for Pere Milla.
76' A substitution has been made. Roberto Fernandez Jaen goes off and Exposito (Espanyol) comes on.
76' Manolo Gonzalez is forced to make a change. Fernando Calero is unable to continue due to injury, Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) comes on.
75' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
72' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
71' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Ionut Radu makes a comfortable save.
70' It's time for a substitution. Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) comes on in place of Iago Aspas.
70' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Javier Rueda is replaced by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo).
68' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) hammered the ball from a long-range free kick only into the defensive wall.

67' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Isidro Diaz stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a free kick to Espanyol in a dangerous position.
64' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

63' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Celta Vigo win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
60' Here comes a substitution. Ramon Terrats is given a rest as he is replaced by Kike Garcia (Espanyol).
57' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.

54' Celta Vigo slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

51' That didn't go as planned! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Marko Dmitrovic, who easily kept it out.
48' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) commits a rough foul. Isidro Diaz stops the game and makes a call.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Pere Milla (Espanyol) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
36' Wonderful movement by Celta Vigo. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
33' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle. Pere Milla (Espanyol) commits a foul after dangerous play.
29' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
27' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.

26' Play continues despite the shouts by some Celta Vigo players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Isidro Diaz interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
18' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
13' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) tackles a bit over-zealously and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.
8' It looks like Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) saw red with that tackle. Isidro Diaz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

5' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Espanyol are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

1' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Espanyol force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz is the one to supervise the game today.
